description: Security & Sandboxing settings page. Configures agent sandboxing policies following the AST 7-layer defense model: compute isolation, resource limits, filesystem boundaries, network mediation, credential proxy, action governance, and audit logging. Supports three built-in profiles (permissive/standard/strict) plus a custom profile editor with full sub-policy configuration.
